blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Legacy USDv is 100% on Solana. Finalized getAccountInfo context 458735842 (2026-10-19T06:36:37Z; blockTime 1792391797) observes an 82-byte legacy SPL Token mint owned by Tokenkeg with freezeAuthority=null, mintAuthority 7XAdHs5QBYaHPwi9Vkj7aSMA4ZzcfazBb8kB2LEPncoa, supply 1514736.240837068. A later read at context 458737227 agrees. These are context-bound current reads, not historical account-archive proofs. SPL transfer authority remains owner/delegate; a null freeze authority cannot be re-enabled, and upgrading a separate mint program does not grant arbitrary Tokenkeg transfers or burns. The direct surface missed by the earlier review is redemption: Solomon's published legacy Vault IDL binds the deployed D4AiKFxj program, defines redeem with user_permissions PDA seeds['vault-state',redeemer], can_redeem boolean, and explicit not-approved/not-whitelisted redemption errors. Live program-owned 42-byte Permissions accounts, filtered by sha256('account:Permissions')[:8] at finalized context 458738108, include 15 enabled and 3 disabled redeemers. The disabled keys are B3sAwcD8Md4hVY3WK7bpdA14rM5SnSQUP3XfBsdTKEkc, GTi2AojokXJfZCRCpikpTRcaf2wBNoxgzCzQK2REr3CZ, and 964QL9XXtMZGAGAsZHqEMcFYrarkEyKgesS3ADE6uCzg; their associated permissions accounts are 8EmXt3iwJLEC35tAzNUzD4of1qaKYBqSk8MZCUQLpWF3, DcF2kPU6PfKhVP6ztHhjyeZLAQJdy8Yf4THgNVajtNvV, JABcnfV1rfSnxip4W81peHoRqqBcDHgcuu5jUej8mz7X. Current token-account queries 458738143-144 show the first has one zero-balance USDv account and the other two none; therefore no named funded victim or successful blocked-redemption simulation is claimed. getMultipleAccounts context 458738049 decodes VaultState account 7XAdHs5Q with discriminator e4c452a562d2eb98, the legacy mint, and role managers GLhsEk8HReGTuPx31qGzzKKYcXy2K1uqBjqp4a4zE8oR/F9scqBt7h55j1xCLS7nkmJzj5KoYmJ9ue9CMf3NZTX7J. VaultState admin and programData 9JWSfaJZ6iVARqkJvbVKCjW5xuy1LaZ3xfWRQmfCEWo2 upgrade authority are CSJJKrBP32T71Zqto6hm7Yi8LXd7eBTWn7piFxCjQfsY. Configurable holder-specific redemption gates meet Possible even though token transfers are unfreezable. The decisive point is the configured/reconfigurable control, not a demonstrated currently funded blocked holder. Reserve remeasurement: https://data.solomonlabs.io/api/solomon-protocol/reserve-history?from=2026-08-28&to=2026-08-29&limit=366&offset=0 returns Ceffu BTC 362439.43, SOL 2602.41, vaultUSDC 83957.34, USDT 17521.46, no other physical reserve rows. Identified 466520.64/historical TVL 1514736.25=30.79880342%; missing 1048215.61=69.20119658%. The history endpoint's entire Aug28-Oct19 range never supplies a reconciling extra bucket; balances fall to vestigial amounts from Sep16. Current protocol-data is dated validFor 2026-10-05, headline 8300313.727113, and only 76.19 in reported custody/vault/distributor/reserve totals; inverse hedge notional 561679.99 is not additive backing. The issuer's Aug28 wind-down disclosure explicitly separates legacy and replacement tokens/reserve models and says holders exit legacy into USDC. The primary Meteora API https://dlmm.datapi.meteora.ag/pools/DmXXwEcK2c7fuVoW6TBzF5UDByhuQBHZS1qHnwprvHFH identifies the legacy USDv/USDC pool and reports 166758.827856 USDC plus 167924.721556 USDv; LP ownership and the dated legacy reserve assignment are unproven, so pool balances cannot be inserted into the missing 69.2% bucket. April 1 Ceffu aggregate attestation 954454.71 is dated and client-wide, not an Aug28/current mint-to-reserve reconciliation. Historical reserve exposure remains 30.7988..100%; current complete-book exposure remains 0..100%. Exactly missing: issuer-attributed legacy reserve/custody/LP ownership balances and liabilities at the SAME date, including the 1048215.61 historical residual. Those unresolved reserves do not affect Possible from the direct redemption gate. Sources: https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com; https://github.com/SolomonLabs/solomon-program-examples/blob/main/src/programs/idl/vault.json; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/solana-program/token/405c9172df3aeb508712142aae1caf0d31ada671/program/src/processor.rs; https://blog.solomonlabs.org/p/winding-down-the-original-usdv; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SolomonLabs/attestations/main/ceffu/2026/2026-04-01.pdf.

oracleRisk.summary: USDv is issued against Solomon-managed custody assets and delta-neutral hedge positions rather than borrower debt positions with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Solomon's USDv reserve model tracks a system-wide reserve portfolio and reserve ratio while approved counterparties mint and redeem against dollar-denominated reserves; its basis-trade and reserve operations therefore use top-level portfolio values rather than borrower-specific debt pricing. No borrower-owned collateral or liquidation branches exist for USDv, so the disposition is top-level-only.
